name: bushdrum-events
description: Bushdrum is a read-only MCP server for city-scoped event discovery. It exposes two tools: list_cities for available Bushdrum cities, and search_events for structured event search within one explicit city using filters like category, vibe, audience, neighborhood, date, price, language, and time.
